about_the_game:
Overview

The Triminals is a traditional turn-based Roguelike that blends squad tactics with deckbuilding mechanics. Assemble a team of three unique characters as they emerge from the void beyond time, returning to their fragmented pasts to confront their enemies and uncover the truth behind time and fate.

Key Features

Push Your Hand

During combat, all characters' decks are shuffled together! Cards are drawn and distributed sequentially to each character's hand slots. Strategically play or reposition cards to manipulate turn order and maximize their effects.

Character-Driven Branches

Each character's distinct past creates branching paths, offering unique optional challenges and narrative events that shape your journey.

Build Your Team

Expand your deck with new cards while unlocking specialized hand slots for each character—enabling deep customization and evolving strategies.

Discover in DEMO

  • 4 unique characters, each with 20+ mechanically distinct hand slots

  • 120+ cards with unique effects and synergies

  • 4 enemy factions and formidable bosses
